task_description: Construct task-specific GO augmentation for predicting transcriptional responses to genetic perturbations, using one shared knowledge overlay across the complete supplied gene universe, with large-scale primary-literature acquisition and complete selected database integration.
knowledge_requirements: Integrate complete selected biological database sources across the fixed gene universe using source-defined evidence and mapping policies.

Plan literature reading volume from the biological questions, current knowledge coverage and available resource ceilings. Specify an initial reading volume, a coherent batch size, a full-text ceiling, topic questions and evidence-based stopping criteria.

Read abstracts first. Request body sections or supplementary material to resolve missing entities, relationships or conditions, conflicting evidence, complex composition, large-scale screening results or functional-atlas tables.

Prioritize K562 and hematopoietic context, complemented by transferable human mechanistic evidence with explicit source conditions. Inspect and process eligible large-scale functional and complex-component tables under declared policies.
Use successive topic batches with fresh sessions, saved discovery cursors, paper identity crosswalks, source-bound reading decisions, evidence records, resource usage and unresolved questions.

Query existing gene attributes, typed connections and concept definitions before proposing additions. Reuse equivalent concepts and preserve supporting evidence, biological scope, polarity and conditions. Define new concepts and explain distinctions from matching existing concepts.

Publish candidate increments using the add-go-knowledge skill and shared batch importer. Review individual literature claims and concept resolutions against saved source passages before freezing the shared task knowledge product.
Keep large tables, complete gene lists and paper lists in files. Use compact summaries, selective evidence excerpts, reusable acquisition programs and versioned caches.

retrieval_budget.record_budget_scope: max_candidate_records applies exclusively to literature_extracted candidate statements. Process selected database sources to completion and retain all eligible gene-universe mappings. Database record counts follow source content and declared evidence filters; review sample sizes govern audit inspection only.
retrieval_budget.paper_accounting: Deduplicate papers by DOI, PMID and PMCID cross-references. Count a paper as inspected after reading its accessible scientific text and recording a screening decision. Track discovered, fetched, inspected, full-text-inspected and evidence-contributing papers separately. Record exactly which full-text sections were inspected.
retrieval_budget.source_accounting: Count each opened primary-paper identity once across formats and retries, and each distinct database or reference artifact separately. Record discovery and metadata API requests in the acquisition ledger.
